title.narrative: MA - Deliver methane assessments and roadmap for priority mitigation measures in key source sectors

description.narrative: The project aims to develop a national methane roadmap that synthesises the existing state of knowledge in Morocco of major methane emission sources, priority policies and measures for methane emission reductions, multiple benefits from implementation of policies and measures, possible methane emission reduction targets, and implementation pathways for each priority measure. This will provide all key stakeholders in Morocco with a clear statement of Morocco's methane mitigation ambition, as well as the key arguments as to why action on methane should be acclerated. This project supports the Global Methane Pledge ( GMP initiative) in which Morocco participates.
